verdict.rationale: Clerk ships a first-party remote MCP server. Beyond SDK snippets, it exposes 'Account tools' to create and configure applications, manage users, and set up production instances. This lets a user operate Clerk in natural language through AI clients like Claude, Cursor or Copilot, with a one-command CLI hookup. Clerk has no native natural-language interface of its own, and the operational tool scope rests on a single line of docs. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, detailed documentation of which account operations the MCP tools cover, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
